image_dataset.name: PlantVillage
image_dataset.image_location_and_capture_time: Not supplied as reliable per-image metadata in this project; real weather linkage requires user-provided image coordinates and capture date.

weather_dataset.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
weather_dataset.access: Public API queried per image coordinate and capture date

derived_variables.leaf_wetness_hours: Estimated proxy derived from humidity and precipitation; not directly observed.

alignment.spatial: Image latitude and longitude are supplied by the user and used in the weather query.
alignment.temporal: Image capture date is supplied by the user and used as the daily observation date.
alignment.fallback: Manual environmental values and presets are controlled simulation only and are labeled as unaligned.

current_checkpoint_note: The saved checkpoint has 53 labels and matches the legacy 53-class PlantVillage_Split validation folders. The curated official PlantVillage color setup produces 38 classes and is a different split; it is not compatible with the saved checkpoint. The 53-class validation split can be evaluated without retraining, but its provenance and any use in model selection must be considered before interpreting metrics.
